item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.14 introduces the official faceted-flask application icon.
- Replaces the clipboard icon with the official flask icon in Finder, Applications, the Dock, the App Switcher, and notifications. - Shows the flask artwork at full size in the pipeline panel, Settings, and About headers, using its own transparent rounded corners without added backgrounds or padding. - Refreshes the README icon and screenshots. - Leaves the dynamic menu bar status indicator, GitLab monitoring, project scope, and saved settings unchanged.
If Finder or the Dock still shows the previous icon after updating, relaunch Labwrk; macOS may briefly cache the old artwork.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.13 adds pipeline rerun controls and refines the passed indicator.
- Right-click a pipeline row and choose **Rerun Pipeline** to retry its failed or canceled jobs. - Choose **Rerun Last Job** to retry the most recently started job, including a successful job. Jobs that have never run are excluded. - Disables unavailable rerun actions and prevents overlapping retries for the same pipeline. Successful retries refresh the panel; failures show a clear message. - New GitLab sign-ins request `api` scope, which reruns require. Existing `read_api` connections can continue monitoring; enable `api` scope in the GitLab OAuth application and reconnect, or use an `api` personal access token, to rerun jobs. Project permissions still apply. - Updates the menu bar passed checkmark to the revised supplied SVG.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.12 refreshes the menu bar pipeline indicators.
- Shows a white checkmark for passed pipelines. - Uses filled red, amber, and blue circles with pale borders for failed, warning, and running pipelines. - Reduces spacing between indicators by one point. - Preserves the existing white outline circles for next, cancelled, and nonexistent pipelines.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.
